name: Should I repaint my old baseboards or replace them completely?

mainEntity.name: Should I repaint my old baseboards or replace them completely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repainting existing trim is best when the wood is structurally sound, firmly attached, and free from extensive rot or deep water damage. If your baseboards have minor scuffs, nail holes, or faded paint, filling and repainting is the most cost-effective solution. However, replacing trim is better if the wood is warped, swollen from water, or if you want taller modern profiles to match a broader remodel. Because HH Remodeling specializes in both finish carpentry and painting, our crew can replace cracked sections and seamlessly blend new trim with your existing woodwork.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repaint if the trim is straight and structurally sound with only cosmetic wear. Replace if the wood is warped, rotted, water-damaged, or too outdated for your design goals.
